_comment: Unpublished hosted-template snapshot, not automatically imported by Railway. Keep secrets as expressions. Update the pinned image after proxy trust and automatic cluster addressing are released.
name: AstralBeam
description: Self-host AstralBeam with PostgreSQL 18 and private object storage.

HOST.description: HTTP bind address used by the container. Leave as 0.0.0.0.

PORT.description: HTTP port used by Platform, the public domain, and Railway healthchecks. Leave as 3000.

TRUST_PROXY.description: Trust Railway's HTTPS edge headers for initial setup. Keep origin access restricted to trusted Railway services.

CLIENT_IP_HEADERS.description: Client IP header supplied by Railway's HTTP edge. Leave as x-real-ip.

S3_BUCKET.description: Private S3 bucket name supplied by Files. Leave this reference unchanged.

S3_REGION.description: S3 signing region supplied by Files. Leave this reference unchanged.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: HTTPS S3 endpoint supplied by Files. Used by the server and signed browser downloads.

APP_BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS origin supplied by Railway. Update this if you attach a custom domain.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection supplied by the Postgres service. Leave this reference unchanged.

S3_PATH_STYLE.description: Use virtual-hosted addressing for newly created Railway buckets. Leave as false.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: S3 access key supplied by Files. Independent of any email or model credentials.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: S3 secret supplied by Files. Leave this reference unchanged.

DATABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generated when this template is first deployed. Used for encryption and operator sign-in at /configure. Preserve and back up this key.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow 15 seconds for HTTP draining and workflow cleanup after SIGTERM.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down
